name: source_operating_point_v1
status: frozen before computing any result under this definition

user_decision_2026_11_08.source_detector: GBT (130-d window statistics, HistGradientBoosting max_iter 400, lr 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, random_state 0, balanced sample weights); deployment fit = artifacts/ens_internal_test_v1_20261105/gbt_full_train.pkl (full train, sha256 df468524e2047205dd8422ab3e486ce7692f0ac312276e20394d6f88a1bb6774)
user_decision_2026_11_08.deep_backbone_for_cross_domain: T1 MSTCA recipe (pure 26-ch MSTCA, fixed 100 epochs); not a detector at this stage
user_decision_2026_11_08.operating_point: strict per-class recall >= baseline, excluding late-hover mode-4 GPS (unobservable z!=1 and no-physical-effect z=1 / identity) from the hard constraints

basis: Q1 (configs/experiments/q1_source_model_selection_v1.json, KEEP=GBT) and Q2 (configs/experiments/q2_late_hover_gps_observability_v1.json: late-hover mode-4 GPS is input-limited or has no measurable effect in hover)
data_boundary: train CV held-out predictions only (162069 windows, folds sha256('h1cv|'+association_group)%3). No val, internal test or Real. No training.
disclosure: GBT and T0 train-CV predictions were already analysed in E/Q1; this fixes the operating point and threshold of the chosen model, it is not an independent confirmation. The deployment GBT fit was already scored once on the internal test (ens_internal_test_v1, 2026-11-06); any further internal-test use needs a separate plan and explicit user approval.

baseline.model: T0 MSTCA (t_selection_mstca_v1 selections.json T0 epoch), seeds 42-46
baseline.reference_threshold: T0's own FP@R97 threshold per seed (97% recall over all train-CV fault windows)
baseline.targets: per seed, T0 true-positive count in each constrained stratum at that threshold

constrained_strata.excluded_windows: late-hover mode-4 GPS fault windows: hover flight, window_end_row*0.02 > 30 s, class GPS, case fault mode 4 per artifacts/q2_gps_fault_modes.csv (all z factors, including identity)
strata: GPS fault windows excluding the excluded windows
late-hover GPS mode-3 fault windows (7th stratum, strict)

threshold_rule.per_seed: highest GBT threshold t such that GBT TP >= T0 target in all 7 strata for that seed
threshold_rule.deployment: minimum of the 5 per-seed thresholds (recall >= baseline against every T0 seed)

metrics.primary: normal false alarms at the deployment threshold vs T0 FP@R97 per seed; geometric-mean ratio
metrics.ci: association_group cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, rng 20261106; T0 thresholds, targets and the GBT threshold recomputed in each replicate
secondary: recall per constrained stratum (GBT vs T0 per seed)
disclosure only: recall on the excluded late-hover mode-4 GPS windows (GBT vs T0), split z!=1 / z=1 / identity
out-of-fold transfer: targets and threshold chosen on two folds, applied to the third; FP ratio and per-stratum recall difference vs T0
descriptive reference only: T1 and E1 under the same definition

acceptance.A1: geometric-mean FP ratio < 1 with bootstrap CI upper < 1
acceptance.A2: out-of-fold per-stratum recall deficit vs T0 <= 1 pp for all 7 strata (seed mean)
acceptance.on_fail: report; do not change the definition or pick another model in this round

not_allowed: changing strata, exclusions or threshold rule after results
outputs: artifacts/source_operating_point_v1/evaluation.json; report docs/research/2026-11-08/源域最终模型与工作点_v1.md
